basics.type: Private university in Uttarakhand, formerly Maya Group of Colleges
basics.ugc: UGC-recognised state private university; B.Pharm approved by PCI
basics.other: Engineering, pharmacy, nursing (B.Sc, GNM, ANM), paramedical and allied health, agriculture, management, hotel management and education

admission: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths, 45% (40% for SC/ST)
Maya Devi University admission process; MDUCET and JEE Main scores count for scholarships
Class 12 with PCB or PCM and English, 50% (45% SC/ST); minimum age 17
Admission process; lateral entry for D.Pharm holders
Class 12 with PCB and English, 45–50%; minimum age 17

scholarships.text: Tuition scholarships of 10% to 50% on MDUCET score (65% to 95% and above), on JEE Main percentile, and on NEET rank for pharmacy, allied health and agriculture; plus a merit-cum-means scholarship for Uttarakhand domicile students. Scholarships above 50% need an interview.

fees.text: MDU publishes a 2027-28 fee structure for each programme. Ask us for the current fee for your course.
